meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Validate and plan local genomic-interval workflows

howto.what: 装上后,当用户处理基因组区间数据(如 BED 文件)的机器学习任务时,Claude 会依据该技能指导使用 geniml 包,提供训练区域嵌入(Region2Vec)、联合嵌入(BEDspace)、单细胞分析(scEmbed)、构建共识峰(universe)及命令行操作的步骤。
howto.when: 当用户提出处理 BED 文件、训练区域嵌入、分析单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据或构建共识峰等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 scATAC-seq 数据用 scEmbed 做细胞聚类。
say.note: Claude 会指导准备 AnnData、训练并生成嵌入。

say.text: 用 geniml 构建 consensus peaks universe。

howto.what_en: After installation, when handling genomic interval data (e.g., BED files) for ML tasks, Claude uses this skill to guide the geniml package: steps for Region2Vec, BEDspace, scEmbed, consensus peak building, and CLI usage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user works with BED files, trains region embeddings, analyzes scATAC-seq data, or builds consensus universes.

say_en.text: Use geniml to train Region2Vec embeddings on BED files in bed_files.
say_en.note: Provides tokenization, training, and evaluation steps.

say_en.text: Help me cluster this scATAC-seq data with scEmbed.
say_en.note: Guides AnnData prep, training, and embedding generation.

say_en.text: Build a consensus peaks universe with geniml.
say_en.note: Explains CC, CCF, ML, HMM methods and commands.
